A '''drum-like creature''' was used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] to create [[Music/Legends|music]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. It was used alongside [[crab-harp]]s on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] by Yuuzhan Vong attendants.
